source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 645 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-645.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 645 was established by Ordinance No. 25281, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 11, 2003. (Ord. 25281)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-645.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 645 is established on property located on the west side of Edgefield Avenue between Clarendon Drive and Nolte Drive. The size of PD 645 is approximately 4.84 acres. (Ord. 25281)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-645.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. 25281)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-645.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) For a public school use, development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 645A). In the event of a conflict between the text of this article and the development plan, the text of this article controls.

(b) For all other permitted uses, no development plan is required, and the provisions of Section 51A-4.702 regarding submission of or amendments to a development plan, site analysis plan, conceptual plan, development schedule, and landscape plan do not apply. (Ord. 25281)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-645.105. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

The only main uses permitted in this district are:

(1) a public school other than an open-enrollment charter school (permitted by right); and

(2) all other main uses permitted in the R-7.5(A) Single Family District subject to the same conditions applicable to uses in that district set out in Chapter 51A. For example, if a use is permitted only by specific use permit (SUP) in the R-7.5(A) Single Family District in Chapter 51A, it is permitted only by SUP in this district; if a use is subject to development impact review (DIR) in the R- 7.5(A) Single Family District in Chapter 51A, it is subject to DIR in this district; etc. (Ord. 25281)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-645.106. ACCESSORY USES.

(a) As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217.

(b) In this district, the following accessory uses are not permitted:

-- Accessory outside display of merchandise. -- Accessory outside sales. -- Accessory pathological waste incinerator. (Ord. 25281)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-645.107. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. In the event of a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) In general. Except as otherwise provided in this section, the yard, lot, and space regulations contained in Section 51A-4.112(f), “R-7.5(A) District,” apply.

(b) Regulations for a public school use.

(1) Front yard. Minimum front yard is as shown on the development plan.

(2) Side and rear yard. Minimum side and rear yards are as shown on the development plan.

(3) Floor area ratio. No maximum floor area ratio.

(4) Height. Maximum structure height is 30 feet.

(5) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is 42 percent. Aboveground parking structures are included in lot coverage calculations; surface parking lots and underground parking structures are not.

(6) Lot size. No minimum lot size.

(7) Stories. Maximum number of stories above grade is two. (Ord. Nos. 25281; 26894)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-645.108. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) Except as otherwise provided in this section, consult the use regulations contained in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking/loading requirements for each use.

(b) For a public school use, off-street parking must be provided as required by the Dallas Development Code, but not less than 78 spaces, and located as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 25281; 26894)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-645.109. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 25281)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-645.110. LANDSCAPING.

(a) In general. Landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(b) Maintenance. All existing and new plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition.

(c) Regulations for a public school use.

(1) Design standards. One design standard must be a foundation planting strip.

(2) Street trees. Street trees with a minimum caliper of four inches must be provided on Clarendon Avenue for each 50 feet of street frontage prior to the issuance of a certificate of occupancy for any new classroom and located as shown on the attached development plan. A minimum of five street trees, each with a minimum caliper of four inches, must be provided on Nolte Drive between any new structure and the property line and between the westernmost off-street parking area and the property line within thirty days after completion of the off-street parking area and located as shown on the development plan.

(3) Hedgerow. A hedgerow capable of achieving a solid appearance within three years must be maintained at a minimum height of three feet along the western line of the westernmost off- street parking area shown on the attached development plan.

(4) Site trees. A minimum of six site trees, no more than 50 feet on center, must be provided in the western portion of the Property in the location shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 25281; 26894)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-645.111. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts in Article VII. (Ord. 25281)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-645.112. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) Maintenance. The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Compliance. Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(c) Regulations for a public school use.

(1) Existing fencing is permitted in locations shown on the development plan.

(2) New fences may not exceed five feet in height. (Ord. Nos. 25281; 26102; 26894)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-645.113. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, in this district until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 25281; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-645.114. ZONING MAP.

PD 645 is located on Zoning Map No. L-6. (Ord. 25281)
